p.PROJECT-RUNS-A-PERIODIC-HEALTH-AUDIT: This project runs a **periodic health audit**: a recurring, judgment-heavy sweep over everything the per-commit gate cannot see, recorded as an append-only trend in `AUDIT.md`.

p.THE-GATE-IS-THE-FLOOR-THE-AUDIT-IS-WHAT-: **The gate is the floor; the audit is what the gate cannot see.**

p.THE-GATE-AND-THE-AUDIT-ANSWER-DIFFERENT-: Where the gate answers *"did this commit regress covered code?"*, the audit answers *"what is wrong, rotting, or drifting that no commit will ever flag?"*.

p.AUDIT-IS-OWNER-TRIGGERED-WITH-A-ONCE-PER: The audit is **owner-triggered**, with a floor of **at least once per milestone** — run as part of, or right after, a milestone close-out.

p.A-MILESTONE-IS-NEVER-DECLARED-DONE-ON-AN: A milestone is never declared done on an un-audited base.

p.OWNER-RE-RUNS-AT-WILL-AND-NO-CALENDAR-CR: The owner re-runs it at will between milestones; no calendar cron is fixed.

p.ONE-DATED-SECTION-PER-RUN-EACH-FINDING-C: One dated section in `AUDIT.md` per run, each finding carrying an ID, its category, a one-line locator, a severity (P1/P2/P3), and a disposition (fixed/filed/accepted/open).

p.AUDIT-MD-IS-COMMITTED-AND-ITS-HISTORY-IS: `AUDIT.md` is committed to git — its history *is* the project's health trend.

p.UNRESOLVED-FINDINGS-CARRY-FORWARD-AND-GE: Unresolved findings carry forward to the next run and get re-judged.

p.USE-THE-HEALTH-AUDIT-SKILL-TO-RUN-ONE: Use the **`health-audit`** skill: it reads the category checklist, walks it against the repository, and drafts the `AUDIT.md` section for your approval.

item.NEVER-DECLARE-A-MILESTONE-DONE-ON-AN-UN-: Never declare a milestone done on an un-audited base — the audit is part of the close-out, not an optional extra.

item.NEVER-LET-A-FINDING-VANISH-WITHOUT-A-DIS: Never let a finding vanish without a disposition. Every finding is fixed, filed, accepted, or open — silence is not an option.

item.NEVER-KEEP-FINDINGS-ONLY-IN-THE-VOLATILE: Never keep findings only in the volatile checkpoint file (the WAL / CONTINUE). The durable home is `AUDIT.md`; the checkpoint is reconciled *against* it, never a substitute for it.

item.NEVER-LET-THE-CHECKLIST-FOSSILIZE: Never let the checklist fossilize. A new defect class a run discovers becomes a permanent category, so the same gap is never re-missed.

item.NEVER-MISTAKE-A-GREEN-GATE-FOR-A-HEALTHY: Never mistake a green gate for a healthy project. The gate is blind by construction to uncovered code, out-of-gate trees, drift, and slow debt — each individually invisible, collectively corrosive.
